message: その名は偉大な引越し先

name: Helena
message: 「We've decided on Azel-chan's new place to move into.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's great, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I didn't mind sleeping outside, you know... Still, it's all thanks to you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You really aren't honest with yourself, Azel-san. At times like this, you're supposed to hug the President to express your joy.」

name: Azel
message: 「L-Like I could do that!」

name: Helena
message: 「It's quite a nice apartment. The rent is cheap, and it's close to the academy.」

name: Helena
message: 「In the yard, edible plants lovingly tended by the caretaker show their seasonal beauty all year round, and there are even cute pets.」

name: Misa
message: 「...That property sounds too good to be true.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah... though I kind of feel like I know it.」

name: Helena
message: 「It's called Grand Palace Sakura--doesn't that sound grand?」

name: Synn
message: 「That apartment name sure rings a bell.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The name part in particular carries an indefinable sense of familiarity.」

name: Azel
message: 「Agreed.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hey.」

name: Ria
message: 「It must be famous for having a great living environment.」

name: Helena
message: 「Everyone, please help her out when she moves, okay? Synn-chan will show you where it is.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? I know that apartment?」

name: Helena
message: 「You know it best of all, Synn-chan.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, hey! That's Synn's place!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh! Now this is a surprise.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I thought you knew and were just playing dumb.」

name: Misa
message: 「Who could ever imagine a dump like that having such a grand name!」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm not lying. It's close to the academy, and most importantly, the Student Council President manages it, so you'll be safe, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not safe! Not safe at all!」

name: Azel
message: 「Why?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Why, you ask? Well, um, a boy and a girl under the same roof.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's obvious!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It does look like it could collapse at any moment. Indeed.」

name: Azel
message: 「No, that is merely an impression from the exterior. From what I saw of the interior, it is well-maintained, and I do not believe there are any safety issues.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, that's wrong, completely wrong.」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan, the academy will even pay you rent.」

name: Synn
message: 「Rent... what a lovely-sounding word. Does this make me nouveau riche too?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, that's not the issue here!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Since I don't charge Sally-chan, charging Azel might be a problem.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wrooong.」

name: Ria
message: 「Still... it might not be a bad idea.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ehh, even you, Big Sister, what are you saying!」

name: Ria
message: 「Azel-chan has encountered Demons many times, right? When it keeps happening like this, it's hard to think it's a coincidence.」

name: Misa
message: 「...Are you saying the Demons are targeting Azel-san.」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As expected of the Chairwoman. You seem to act on impulse, yet you actually think things through. That's what they call 'a fool's thoughts are like resting,' right.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's wildly wrong.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's true that this way, they'll commute together both ways, making her easier to protect...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a heavy responsibility. I'll do my best.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's not as if I need your protection... However, if you insist that much... I suppose I can allow you to protect me...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, could it be I'm the only one against this?」

name: Misa
message: 「And then, as he kept protecting her, the girl's heart began to flutter for the boy.」

name: Misa
message: 「One rainy night, terrified of the thunder, the girl came to the boy's room, and finally--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Finally? What happens after that? I have a feeling it's going to be exciting!」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph, how trivial. Still, what does happen?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's the problem! Nothing can be allowed to happen after that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah! It's a huge scandal that'll shake the whole town to its core!」

name: Everyone
message: 「We oppose the Student Council encouraging improper relationships between boys and girls!」

name: Synn
message: 「Improper relationships?! W-We don't have that kind of relationship!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're gonna soon enough! And I won't allow it! More importantly, just what kind of relationship *do* you have?! Spill every last detail from start to finish!」

name: Azel
message: 「What is an 'improper relationship'?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?! Um, well, that's...」

name: Ria
message: 「It's okay. Synn isn't the kind of boy who would do something like that.」

name: Misa
message: 「Indeed, it's just as Big Sister says. He certainly doesn't look like he has the guts for it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're convinced that easily?!」

name: Ria
message: 「That's not really what I meant, though.\s02」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan's so nice! Synn-sama, you're pathetic as a man!」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh... Well, if this settles things peacefully...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In other words, you're a wimp, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「At the very least, I'm not a wimp!」

name: Azel
message: 「I do not quite understand, but... if an 'improper relationship' is something sinful, then Synn Sakura would never do such a thing to me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...You're really stating that with total certainty.」

name: Azel
message: 「There is no way he would ever bring me harm.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」
She really trusts me that much...

name: Helena
message: 「Listen, Nanaka-chan. Seriously speaking, at this rate, regular students could get caught up in the fight between the demons and those of us protecting Azel-chan, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so...」

name: Helena
message: 「It's only a temporary measure until Re-Crea is over.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well... Azel doesn't even know what improper heterosexual relationships are, anyway...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Plus, Sally-chan is up in the attic, so it should be fine.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not an attic, it's the space between the first and second floors. And what's 'fine'?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, if you don't get it, that's fine, don't worry about it. Ahaha.」

name: Helena
message: 「Looks like Nanaka-chan is on board too. Alright, everyone help her out with moving, okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary. I have no personal belongings.」

name: Misa
message: 「What about your textbooks?」

name: Azel
message: 「They are all stored in my locker.」

name: Misa
message: 「We have a delinquent!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A delinquent indeed.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You mustn't sneak onto campus in the middle of the night and smash windows, okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「Why would I do something so irrational?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「People who leave all their textbooks in their lockers are delinquents, and delinquents are required to do things like that.」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't think they're actually required to do that, you know?」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. If that is the rule, I shall do it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Do not do it, okay.\s01」
